Erica (Japanese: エリコ Eriko) is a recurring character in . She is a Pokémon Coordinator.

==History==
Erica debuted in Mean With Envy. She and her boyfriend were training together for the Pacifidlog Town . Erica hoped that she and Joshua would be the first couple to become winners in the Contest.

Much to Erica's chagrin, began training with Joshua. They were only doing so as friends, but Erica refused to believe May's story. She was convinced that May was going to steal Joshua away from her.

During the Contest in Pacifidlog Jam, Joshua faced off against May in the Contest Battles. Erica hoped that Joshua would defeat her, but she was stunned when May ended up defeating him. Now more than ever, Erica wanted to defeat May. However, when May defeated Erica, the Coordinator had a change of heart. She told May that she was jealous of her, and that she shouldn't have been.

She and Joshua both had cameos in Deceit and Assist, where they were watching May on TV during the Hoenn Grand Festival.

==Character==
Erica was immediately jealous of after spotting her talking with her boyfriend . However, despite May and Joshua's reassurances of otherwise, Erica remained jealous and set on capturing Joshua's attention. During the Contest, Erica hoped that she and Joshua would be the ones to win the event and share the Ribbon. However, her dreams were shattered when May defeated Joshua and advanced to the final round. Erica later had a change of heart after Joshua revealed his feelings on the jealousy, and she gained a respect of May.

==Pokémon==
 

==Contests==
Erica has competed in the following Pokémon Contests:
Contest - Runner-Up (Pacifidlog Jam)

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
 
A female cheerleader in Triple Leaders, Team Threats!, Dreams by the Yard Full!, and Cilan Takes Flight! bears a remarkable resemblance to Erica.
